# Fleet Operations v20 — Screenshot and PDF reconciliation

**Reference materials:** four screenshots of Accounts → Reports → Fleet Operations (20 November 2026), plus `fleet-operations_2026-11-14_2026-11-20.pdf` (4 pages, landscape A4, 841.89 × 595.28 pt, generated by jsPDF 4.2.1).

**Scope:** All report cells must come from GDS data for the selected filters. The PDF is a visual/layout reference, **not a fixture to copy its figures into the product**. The GDS demo database contains different schedules, vehicles, crew and expenses from the supplied competitor export.

## Screenshot 1 — heading, filters, KPIs, By Bus
- Preserve the Accounts submenu with Sales, Transactions, Receivables, **Reports**, Invoices, OTA Invoice Verifier, Agent Settings, Loyalty.
- Back to Reports link, Fleet Operations title, blue Print pill, grey-blue PDF and Share pills.
- Staff dropdown (All drivers / staff), bus dropdown (All buses), two dates with purple calendar badges, `Last 7 days`, `This month`, `Last month`.
- Explanatory metric paragraph; utilization denominator uses eligible main-bus days, km/L only paired km+fuel observations, assigned drivers each receive full trips; diesel cost fallback disclosed.
- **12 KPI tiles in two rows:** Fleet util, Trips, Buses, Drivers, Km (GPS), Fuel (L), Mileage, Diesel, Idle bus-days, Trips without bus, Trips turned off, Trips without driver.
- **By Bus**: Bus, Trips, Days ran, Days idle, Util, Km (GPS), Km (route), Fuel (L), km/L, Diesel, ₹/km, Drivers. Totals below table. Includes idle main buses.
- Rounded white cards, subtle slate borders, pale section headers, dense aligned rows, fixed/sticky summary row, vertical and horizontal scrolling.

## Screenshots 2 and 4 — By Driver and Driver × Bus
- **By Driver:** Driver, Phone, Trips, Days, Km (GPS), Fuel (L), km/L, vs bus avg, Buses; total row. Assigned drivers counted fully, not divided by number of drivers.
- **Driver × Bus:** Driver, Bus, Trips, Km (GPS), Fuel (L), km/L, Bus avg km/L, vs bus avg; total row.
- Baseline is the combined paired km/fuel of each bus over all its trips in the selected date range (not a mean of rounded per-trip ratios). Missing readings show em dash rather than zero efficiency.
- Separate scrollable tables with sticky headers and footers.

## Screenshot 3 — Daily and Trip-wise
- **Daily:** Date, Fleet, Used, Trips, Util, No bus, Off, Km (GPS), Fuel (L), km/L, Diesel, Idle buses. Each day in selected interval appears, including zero-trip days. Total footer summarises bus-days and idle bus-days.
- **Trip-wise:** Date, Dep, Service, Route, Bus, Driver(s) with phone numbers, Crew with role/phone, Km (GPS), Fuel (L), km/L, Diesel. Chronological order, total row.

## Reference PDF — 4 pages
- **A4 landscape vector PDF** with centered `Fleet Operations` title.
- First-page left header: operator name, Period, Generated, Fleet util, Trips, Buses, Drivers, Km (GPS).
- First-page right header: Fuel (L), Mileage, Diesel, Idle bus-days, Trips without bus, Trips turned off, Trips without driver.
- Five sections in this order: **By bus**, **By driver**, **Driver × bus**, **Daily**, **Trip-wise**.
- Saturated blue column-header bands with white lettering; alternating white/off-white rows; light grey cell grids; blue section divider; pale grey, bold section-total rows.
- Break across pages without clipping rows; repeat column headers on page breaks; include all filtered rows; no hardcoded printed report totals or dates.
- Indian number grouping and `Rs.` on PDF like the reference; `₹` used on screen.
- Server-generated binary PDF is offered by the **PDF** action and can be opened in an independent reader. Print uses browser print CSS. Share uses native sharing or copies the filter-preserving URL.

## Data contracts
- `GET /api/accounts/reports/fleet-operations/options` supplies permitted staff and buses for dropdowns.
- `GET /api/accounts/reports/fleet-operations?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD&staff_id=&bus_id=` supplies all five tables, summary, methodology and totals.
- `GET /api/accounts/reports/fleet-operations.pdf?...` returns the same selection as an authenticated downloadable PDF.
- Existing `format=csv` trip export remains available.
- All endpoints enforce `accounts.reports`. Invalid dates, swapped intervals, unknown filters and periods exceeding 366 days are rejected.

## Acceptance
- `node tests/check-fleet-operations-v20.cjs`
- `node tests/fleet-operations-v20-ui.cjs`
- `npm test`
- `.github/workflows/fleet-operations-v20.yml` also generates a demo report and checks A4 landscape metadata, text extraction and PDF page rendering using Poppler.

**Limitations:** The frontend was matched against supplied screenshots, not compared against a live competing site's computed DOM. The PDF layout is recreated using native vector drawing and built-in Helvetica, not the competitor's proprietary source template/fonts. Exact source figures are only reproducible when the GDS is populated with the same operational data. Development GPS telemetry remains unverified; live Intangles ingestion is not implied.
